lines.zh: 我用嘴啃礁石，啃出一道白痕。
lines.en: I scrape the rock with my beak, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 七条一起过礁，像一阵绿风。
lines.en: Seven of us cross the reef like a green wind.

lines.zh: 我边游边啃，身后留下沙。
lines.en: I swim and chew, and sand trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我的牙长在嘴唇上，像鹦鹉的喙。
lines.en: My teeth sit on my lips like a parrot's beak.

lines.zh: 珊瑚上的藻，我一口刮下来。
lines.en: The algae on the coral comes off in one scrape.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但一路不停。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never stop moving.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，整群都跟着转。
lines.en: One flick of my tail turns the whole school.

lines.zh: 暖水里的礁最对我胃口。
lines.en: The reef in warm water suits my appetite best.

lines.zh: 我咬下的碎屑，会变成海底的沙。
lines.en: What I bite off becomes sand on the seabed.

lines.zh: 我从礁顶游到礁脚，一路吃。
lines.en: I work from the reef top down, eating as I go.

lines.zh: 这块石头太硬，我换个地方。
lines.en: This stone is too hard; I try another spot.

lines.zh: 我身上的绿，是吃出来的。
lines.en: The green on me comes from what I eat.

lines.zh: 同伴咬着同一块礁，各占一头。
lines.en: My companions share one rock, each at its own end.

lines.zh: 深处的礁暗，我的颜色也暗。
lines.en: Deeper reefs are dim, and so are my colors.

lines.zh: 我绕礁游一圈，又回到原处。
lines.en: I circle the reef and return to where I started.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍打开，慢慢地转。
lines.en: I spread my dorsal fin and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我停在礁石上，嘴还在动。
lines.en: I rest on the rock, and my beak keeps working.

lines.zh: 刚啃下来的一口，我慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I chew slowly on the mouthful I just scraped.

lines.zh: 沙从我鳃边漏下去。
lines.en: Sand trickles out past my gills.

lines.zh: 我们七条挤在礁缝里休息。
lines.en: The seven of us crowd a crevice to rest.

lines.zh: 我嘴里有石头，别让我说话。
lines.en: I have stone in my mouth; do not ask me to talk.

lines.zh: 这道白痕是我昨天啃的。
lines.en: This white scar is where I fed yesterday.

lines.zh: 水很清，清得能看见我的喙。
lines.en: The water is clear enough to show my beak.

lines.zh: 我不太动，除非有藻。
lines.en: I stay still unless there is algae.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在水里最好看。
lines.en: My colors look best underwater.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼在捡我咬下的碎屑。
lines.en: A small fish picks up the crumbs I dropped.

lines.zh: 我一张一合，把水从鳃推出去。
lines.en: I open and close, pushing water past my gills.

lines.zh: 礁上安静，只有啃食的声音。
lines.en: The reef is quiet except for scraping.

lines.zh: 我半悬在礁边，等人经过。
lines.en: I hang at the reef edge, waiting for someone to pass.

lines.zh: 这片沙，一半是我做的。
lines.en: Half of this sand was made by me.

lines.zh: 你脚边的沙，有一部分是我。
lines.en: Some of the sand at your feet came from me.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，正好挡住我的礁。
lines.en: You dive down and block the rock I was feeding on.

lines.zh: 我啃珊瑚，碎屑飘给你。
lines.en: I nibble coral, and crumbs drift down to you.

lines.zh: 你的面罩反光，像一片鳞。
lines.en: Your mask glints like a single scale.

lines.zh: 我嘴上的白喙，你大概没见过。
lines.en: You have probably never seen a beak like mine.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就往礁后挪。
lines.en: You reach out, and I slide behind the rock.

lines.zh: 我绕着你看了一圈。
lines.en: I swim one full circle around you.

lines.zh: 你比礁石软，也比礁石快。
lines.en: You are softer than rock, and much faster.

lines.zh: 你在等我动，我就是不动。
lines.en: You wait for me to move; I will not.

lines.zh: 你走开，我才继续啃。
lines.en: Only when you leave do I resume scraping.

lines.zh: 你砍偏了，削掉我半片喙。
lines.en: You missed and shaved half my beak away.

lines.zh: 我一吸气，伤口就抽痛。
lines.en: Every breath sends a stab through the wound.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，把我夹在中间。
lines.en: My companions gather and close around me.

lines.zh: 伤口在鳃边，呼吸有点难。
lines.en: The wound is by my gills, and breathing is hard.

lines.zh: 我掉了颜色，斑也淡了。
lines.en: My color fades, and the spots grow pale.

lines.zh: 这一下我沉到礁脚。
lines.en: That blow drops me to the foot of the reef.

lines.zh: 我还能咬，只是不准了。
lines.en: I can still bite, only less accurately.

lines.zh: 水里的沙混着我的血。
lines.en: Sand in the water is mixed with my blood.

lines.zh: 你砍了两次，第二次更疼。
lines.en: You struck twice, and the second hurt more.

lines.zh: 我会记住这块礁和你。
lines.en: I will remember this rock and you.

lines.zh: 我不吃你的饵，我吃石头上的。
lines.en: I do not eat your bait; I eat what grows on stone.

lines.zh: 你撒的东西沉到礁上，我顺路吃。
lines.en: What you scatter lands on the rock, and I graze it.

lines.zh: 藻的味道比饵更让我动心。
lines.en: The smell of algae moves me more than bait.

lines.zh: 你把桶放到礁边，我探头看了看。
lines.en: You set the bucket by the reef, and I peer in.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，不是因为食物。
lines.en: I circle once, and not because of food.

lines.zh: 这一口碎屑刚好落在嘴边。
lines.en: A crumb happens to land right by my mouth.

lines.zh: 你要是敲礁，我会过来。
lines.en: Knock the rock and I will come over.

lines.zh: 我不抢，七条里我排第三。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I am third among seven.

lines.zh: 你放低手，我才肯靠近。
lines.en: Lower your hand, and only then will I approach.

lines.zh: 那点东西不够我嚼一口。
lines.en: That is not enough for a single mouthful.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我嘴里的石头掉了。
lines.en: You bump me, and the stone drops from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我撞在礁上，白痕又深了一点。
lines.en: I hit the rock and the white scar deepens.

lines.zh: 七条散开，又很快聚回来。
lines.en: The seven scatter and then gather again quickly.

lines.zh: 你膝盖顶到我，很硬。
lines.en: Your knee jabs into me, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 水里起了一层沙雾，看不见了。
lines.en: A cloud of sand rises, and I cannot see.

lines.zh: 我的喙撞到你的护甲，缺了一角。
lines.en: My beak strikes your armor and chips at the edge.

lines.zh: 退后一点，我尾巴摆不开。
lines.en: Move back; I have no room to swing my tail.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻过来，又翻回去。
lines.en: The bump rolls me over, and I roll back.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，是提醒我该走了。
lines.en: My companion bumps me to say it is time to go.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我咬偏了。
lines.en: That knock made me bite the wrong spot.

lines.zh: 我们并排啃同一块礁。
lines.en: We feed side by side on the same rock.

lines.zh: 他绕着我，颜色变得很亮。
lines.en: He circles me, and his colors turn very bright.

lines.zh: 沙里挖个浅坑，就是我们的床。
lines.en: A shallow pit in the sand is our bed.

lines.zh: 七条变八条，只是时间问题。
lines.en: Seven becoming eight is only a matter of time.

lines.zh: 我们撞撞嘴，就算说定了。
lines.en: We knock our beaks together and consider it settled.

lines.zh: 这段日子谁都不许靠太近。
lines.en: For these days, nobody may come too close.

lines.zh: 卵沉到沙里，我们一起看着。
lines.en: The eggs sink into the sand, and we both watch.

lines.zh: 她的绿比我深，我认得。
lines.en: Her green is deeper than mine, and I know her.

lines.zh: 我们只守这一小块礁。
lines.en: We guard only this one small patch of reef.

lines.zh: 之后还是一起啃石头。
lines.en: Afterward we go back to scraping rock together.

lines.zh: 我用喙叼起一块碎珊瑚。
lines.en: I lift a piece of broken coral in my beak.

lines.zh: 它太硬，我咬了两下就吐了。
lines.en: It is too hard; I bite twice and spit it out.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我都要试一口。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I must try one bite.

lines.zh: 我把它推到沙坑里，用沙盖住。
lines.en: I push it into a pit and cover it with sand.

lines.zh: 这粒东西不像石头，我留着。
lines.en: This one is not like stone, so I keep it.

lines.zh: 同伴来抢，我转身就游。
lines.en: My companion comes for it, and I turn and swim.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满东西，说不出话。
lines.en: My mouth is full, so I cannot speak.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑从我鳃边漏走了。
lines.en: The crumbs slip away past my gills.

lines.zh: 我只捡能吃或能咬的。
lines.en: I take only what I can eat or bite.

lines.zh: 它卡在礁缝里，我够不到。
lines.en: It is stuck in the crevice, out of reach.

lines.zh: 你在礁上刮东西，我听见了。
lines.en: You are scraping the reef, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 那声音和我的喙很像。
lines.en: That sound is very like my own beak.

lines.zh: 我停下来，头朝着你。
lines.en: I stop feeding and turn my head to you.

lines.zh: 网落下来，整群都散了。
lines.en: The net drops, and the whole school breaks apart.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一块活珊瑚。
lines.en: You crushed a piece of living coral.

lines.zh: 我先看你，再看你的手。
lines.en: I look at you, then at your hands.

lines.zh: 这片礁的沙是我们做的。
lines.en: The sand on this reef was made by us.

lines.zh: 我把喙对着你，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I aim my beak at you and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 你在礁边站得太久了。
lines.en: You have stood at the reef edge too long.

lines.zh: 我不走，我先守这块石头。
lines.en: I will not leave; I hold this rock first.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游，嘴一直张着。
lines.en: I swim close beside you with my beak open.

lines.zh: 你往哪刮，我就往哪跟。
lines.en: Wherever you scrape, I follow along.

lines.zh: 我绕到你的影子里，再出来。
lines.en: I slip into your shadow and come out again.

lines.zh: 七条都转过来，对着你。
lines.en: All seven of us turn to face you.

lines.zh: 我啃珊瑚的声音，你听见了。
lines.en: You heard me crunching coral.

lines.zh: 我的喙一直对着你的脚。
lines.en: My beak stays aimed at your feet.

lines.zh: 你每刮一下，我就记一下。
lines.en: Every scrape you make, I count.

lines.zh: 沙在我身下飘，我不动。
lines.en: Sand drifts under me, and I hold still.

lines.zh: 你退到礁外，我们才散开。
lines.en: Only when you leave the reef do we scatter.

lines.zh: 这一块礁，我们比你先到。
lines.en: We reached this rock before you did.

lines.zh: 我用喙撞你的手指。
lines.en: I drive my beak into your fingers.

lines.zh: 这一口咬下去，会留印子。
lines.en: This bite will leave a mark on you.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的网，扯开一道口。
lines.en: I bite your net and tear a gap in it.

lines.zh: 你碰我的礁，我就撞你。
lines.en: You touch my rock, so I ram you.

lines.zh: 我的喙不是牙，比牙更硬。
lines.en: My beak is not teeth; it is harder.

lines.zh: 同伴从侧面来，你顾不过来。
lines.en: My companions come from the side; you cannot cover both.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退进礁缝。
lines.en: I bite, then retreat into the crevice.

lines.zh: 水里飘着一点白，是你的血。
lines.en: A little white drifts in the water; it is yours.

lines.zh: 我不追，你走远就算了。
lines.en: I do not chase; walk away and it ends.

lines.zh: 你力气比我大，我知道。
lines.en: You are stronger than I am, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我从暖水那边游进来，嘴里有沙。
lines.en: I swim in from the warm side with sand in my beak.

lines.zh: 七条一起到，礁口都满了。
lines.en: Seven arrive at once and fill the reef mouth.

lines.zh: 我先找一块没被啃过的石头。
lines.en: First I look for a rock nobody has scraped.

lines.zh: 这里的水温，正适合啃礁。
lines.en: The temperature here is right for scraping.

lines.zh: 我一到就开始工作。
lines.en: I begin working the moment I arrive.

lines.zh: 深温水也去，只是那边礁少。
lines.en: We visit deep lukewarm water, but fewer reefs there.

lines.zh: 第一口咬下去，礁石响了。
lines.en: The rock rings with my first bite.

lines.zh: 这片沙还很新，是我先来的。
lines.en: This sand is fresh; I arrived first.

lines.zh: 你看见的那片白痕，是我留的。
lines.en: That white scrape you see is my mark.

lines.zh: 绿影一过，我们就到齐了。
lines.en: A green shadow passes, and we have all arrived.

lines.zh: 水在滚，我的鳃先受不住。
lines.en: The water boils, and my gills give out first.

lines.zh: 我从礁上掉下去，翻了两圈。
lines.en: I fall from the reef and tumble twice.

lines.zh: 出了水，我的喙合不上。
lines.en: Out of the water, my beak will not close.

lines.zh: 冲击把礁石推过来，压住我。
lines.en: The blast shoves the rock over and pins me.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的身体，我还在游。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in me, and I keep swimming.

lines.zh: 紫光一闪，我的颜色全乱了。
lines.en: A purple flash, and all my colors scramble.

lines.zh: 这块礁被啃空了，我找不到藻。
lines.en: This rock is picked clean, and I find no algae.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅水，我全身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows, and my body jerks.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，连沙也空。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me, not even sand remains.
